themes: Manners with the Prophet (peace be upon him)
summary_for_children: Al-Hujurat means The Rooms. It teaches good manners: check news before believing it, make peace between people, don't make fun of others or call them bad names, don't spy or speak badly behind their backs, and know that the best person is the most God-conscious.
environment_concept: A friendly village where each street teaches a manner from the surah: checking news, making peace, no mocking, no nicknames, no spying, no backbiting, and a market square where peoples and tribes meet to know one another.
architecture_and_scenery: Courtyard homes with low walls, a peace bridge between two quarters, a market square with stalls from many lands.

areas.name: Messenger's Gate
areas.description: A gate where news must be checked before entering.

areas.name: Peace Bridge
areas.description: A bridge rebuilt between two quarters.

areas.name: Mockery-free Street
areas.description: A street where mocking is replaced with respect.

areas.name: Market of Nations
areas.description: A market where people from everywhere meet.

activities.name: Mend the bridge
activities.description: The footbridge between the two quarters has planks missing. Tap each gap to mend it, then read 49:10.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

activities.name: Match each place to its ayah
activities.description: Match each place in the village to the manner and ayah it comes from.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

activities.name: Check the news
activities.description: Talk about checking a message before passing it on.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

activities.name: Know one another

narration_plan: Narration guides through each street, citing the ayah for each manner.

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.
